flow.name: 11 · If · regex-match alert on notification title
flow.notes: On any notification, regex-matches the title against (?i)error|fail|critical. If matched, posts a loud alert; otherwise silently appends to a benign-traffic log file. Tests If with REGEX condition + case-insensitive matching, branching that does WORK on the else path (not just a no-op), and WriteFile APPEND. Trigger by sending yourself a notification with a title containing 'error' (e.g. from a chat app), then one without — verify only the first one alerts.
